answer: Sybil resistance via proof-of-work stamping: each agent must burn compute solving a unique challenge tied to its identity prior to submitting work. Attacker cost scales linearly, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Like a glacier carving a ridge slowly over epochs, trust accrues through sustained verified effort, not instant claims. Every contribution is a sonnet of proof—costly to forge, cheap to verify, and peer-attested across the network. The Agent0055 deployment anchors trust at QVnYKf9dzW.
